title: Concept: SonarQube interface disclosed
description: The SonarQube console is served at this endpoint, so the code-analysis interface is reachable from this network position.
applicability: Responses served by a SonarQube deployment.
risk: A reachable SonarQube exposes project names and analysis findings after login and is a frequent target for its own known issues; MEDIUM because the page alone does not prove access.
